channel.title: Local News Wire Broadcast Feed
channel.description: Approved local stories in broadcast order

item.description: Rutland Town Select Board unanimously agreed to support the Walmart supercenter project. They will speak at the December first Act two fifty hearing about economic impacts. Walmart plans to move from downtown Rutland City to the former Diamond Run Mall site.

Vermont's emergency records system remains offline for a second day after a potential security threat. Police and emergency services are using backup manual systems to track information. Emergency response and nine-one-one services continue without interruption.

A survey in Rutland County found that eighty-three percent of residents want more social connection. Barriers include lack of welcoming spaces and transportation challenges. A new coalition will launch in January to help improve social connections across Vermont.

A basset hound helped save her owner who was missing in the Adirondacks. The dog showed up alone at Whiteface Ski Area in Wilmington, New York. Rangers found the man with frostbite, alive thanks to the dog.
